title: Bachmann N Scale Hooker Niagara Falls Tanker Car - Ready to Run
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Model Railroads & Trains:Railroads & Trains:Other Railroads & Trains
descriptionText: The Bachmann N Scale Hooker Niagara Falls NY Tanker Car is a ready-to-go plastic model train car in 1:160 scale. This orange tanker car is designed for N gauge model railroads and operates on DC power. Perfect for collectors or train enthusiasts looking to add a unique piece to their collection.
